scope: ANFP account of the renovated José Sulantay Silva high-performance complex and its 2026 FIFA Forward recognition.
limitations: Current infrastructure is used only as 2026 development/access/elite-support context and is not backcast.

observations.source_entity: José Sulantay Silva High Performance Complex
observations.text_value: The renovated high-performance complex used by Chile's youth national teams includes five pitches, a 300 m² gym, eight changing rooms, medical/clinic spaces, meeting rooms and technical offices.
observations.definition_notes: Structural/context evidence; the observed fact is not itself a direct annual 1–10 rating.
